title: Labor Law
text:
The Labor Law, which was ratified by the Islamic Consultative Assembly in 2/7/1368 [27 April 1989] and some of whose articles were subject to differences between the Islamic Consultative Assembly and the Guardian Council and were reviewed in many sessions of the Expediency Council and, after various articles were amended and as a matter of necessity, granted permission by the Supreme Leader, with the amendment and completion of other articles, containing 203 articles and 121 notes, received final confirmation by the Expediency Council on 21 Aban 1369 [12 November 1990] and, through memo q/267/8840 dated 9/10/1369, reached the president for implementation.

President Akbar Hashemi-Rafsanjani

 

Chapter I: General Definitions and Principles

Chapter II: Labor Contracts

Chapter III: Labor Conditions

Chapter IV: Technical Safety and Occupational Help

Chapter V: Training and Occupation

Chapter VI: Workers' and Employers' Organizations

Chapter VII: Collective Labor Bargaining Contracts

Chapter VIII: The Workplace

Chapter IX: Conflict Resolution Authorities

Chapter X: The Supreme Labor Council

Chapter XI: Punishments

Chapter XII: Miscellaneous Provisions

The above law was ratified by the Islamic Consultative Assembly on 2 Mehr 1368 [24 September 1989]. Some of its articles were subject to dispute between the Islamic Consultative Assembly and the Guardian Council. They held numerous meetings to determine what was expedient for the system and reviewed or amended and completed Articles 3, 7, 8, 12, 15, 20, 24, 26, 27, 29, 31, 32, 33, 41, 46, 51, 52, 53, 56, 58, 59, 60, 62, 64, 65, 66, 67, 69, 70, 73, 81, 105, 108, 110, 111, 112, 113, 114, 118, 119, 130, 131, 135, 136 137, 138, 143, 151, 154, 155, 158, 159, 160, 166, 188, 189, 190, and 202, and all the punishments in Articles 171-186.
